headline: Revenue and profit climb sharply, though margins tighten
summary_short: Nu Holdings' Q1 FY2026 revenue rose 57.2% y/y to $3,538.3 million and net income grew 56.5% y/y to $872.1 million; on the company's own managerial basis, revenue topped $5.3 billion for the first time and ROE closed at 29%, though net income slipped 2.3% q/q as credit-loss allowances jumped 33% q/q.
summary_long: Q1 FY2026 revenue reached $3,538.3M (+57.2% y/y, +12.8% q/q); on Nu's managerial P&L, revenue surpassed $5.3B for the first time (+42% YoY FX-neutral). Net income of $872.1M rose 56.5% y/y but fell 2.3% q/q as credit-loss allowances rose 33% q/q on seasonality, pushing risk-adjusted NIM down 100bp q/q to 9.5% even as headline NIM expanded to 21.1%. Efficiency ratio improved to a record 17.6% (-2.3pp q/q) and ROE was 29% (-4.0pp q/q). Customers grew to 135.2M (+3% q/q) and deposits reached $42.4B (+22% y/y). Management reiterated FY2026 efficiency ratio should land near the ~20% range communicated for the year, with US-expansion capped below 100bp of efficiency-ratio drag through 2027.

drivers.explanation: Company-disclosed: growth was broad-based across credit, float and fee income; managerial revenue crossed $5B for the first time on continued engagement and monetization gains, with ARPAC up 23% y/y FXN.

Company-disclosed: y/y growth reflects overall business scaling; the 2.3% q/q dip stems from credit-loss allowances up 33% q/q on seasonality and portfolio growth, pulling risk-adjusted NIM to 9.5% from 10.5%.
Derived-arithmetic: diluted EPS growth (+55.9% y/y) tracks net income growth (+56.5% y/y) closely, implying a roughly flat diluted share count.
Derived-arithmetic: basic EPS growth (+55.2% y/y) closely tracks net income growth, implying a roughly flat basic share count.
Company-disclosed: efficiency ratio hit a record-low 17.6% (from 19.9% in Q4'25) on ARPAC outperformance and portfolio growth; customers reached 135.2M with Mexico reaching break-even this quarter.
